audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart had phases[3..5] as 'Skill' and phases[6] as 'Veigar' while content win[] and the packet chart give Qiyana all 7 stages.
audit.why: Veigar is dashless with one 20s-cooldown stun; Qiyana holds kill threat at every stage while cage is down, and the content whys already argue Qiyana for every row including 2+ items (win by denying stacks). 51.36% WR, 773 games.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side moved to Qiyana with matching whys.

audit.why: Qiyana spikes 3-5 (cage-dodge all-in), 6 (wall burst — but no low-HP all-ins vs Primordial Burst execute), first item. Veigar's spike is time itself: free Baleful Strike stacks. spikes[] covers all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two copy-paste-bleed bullets; enemyWin/tradeGood/tradeBad were structural templates.
audit.why: Event Horizon (E): 20/18.5/17/15.5/14s, only the edge stuns; Baleful Strike 6s at rank 1 (stack denial matters); Dark Matter cooldown drops with passive stacks; Primordial Burst 120/90/60s executes missing health — never all-in low.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written in; bleed bullets replaced with Veigar-specific advice.

edits.before: Grass Q from the river brush line — the stealth-empowered poke chunks and the lane learns to fear hedges.
edits.after: Level 1 is free pressure — he has only Baleful Strike poke and no stun, so take the passive-empowered trades.

edits.before: W element economy begins: ice for the trades, rock for the executes, grass for the angles.
edits.after: Still yours at 2 — without Event Horizon he cannot punish a single trade you start.

edits.before: E joins: the stick-dash into ice-Q root is your first real kill pattern — pick one window per wave.
edits.after: W-E-Q assembled: dodge or W-dash the cage edge and a dashless Veigar dies to the full string.

edits.before: Element-cycle the trades: E-ice-Q roots, auto, rock-Q the execute line. The lane is a terrain quiz.
edits.after: Kill threat holds through 4-5 — every 20s Event Horizon cooldown is an all-in window he cannot refuse.

edits.before: Supreme Display online — any fight near a wall is a stun lottery you rigged. Hug terrain like rent depends on it.
edits.after: At 6 you out-burst him against a wall — just never all-in while low, since Primordial Burst executes missing health.

edits.before: First item spike: the full element string deletes squishies. Force the brush-line fights.
edits.after: First item deletes him inside one stun-cooldown window — feint the cage out, then commit.

edits.before: Late Qiyana flanks through her own R: shockwave the objective wall, string the stunned, and vanish into grass.
edits.after: Two-plus items you still win by starving his stacks — engage only on the cage's cooldown, never through it.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Check it before every step-up. - W Terrashape (element swap) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Veigar Event Horizon (E): 20s at rank 1 and his only stun — only the cage EDGE stuns; hold near the center or leave before it forms, never dash into the wall. Every one of those 20 seconds it is down is your window. - His Q is 6s poke — sidestep it to deny stacks. - Your R is 120s: it answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: The moment he throws the cage or Dark Matter at the wave, E in — his only stun is down 20s and nothing else stops you.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Rock Q bonus damage scales on missing health — open with brush or ice and keep the rock swing for the execute line.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Grass-Q from stealth, E, auto, W out — the trade ends before he can even place the cage, and stacks stay denied.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: E-ing into a held Event Horizon — your dash carries you through the edge and the stun starts his full combo.

edits.before: Good trade: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather. Bad trade: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Good trade: Grass-Q from stealth, E, auto, W out — the trade ends before he can even place the cage, and stacks stay denied. Bad trade: E-ing into a held Event Horizon — your dash carries you through the edge and the stun starts his full combo.

edits.before: Veigar wins by landing Event Horizon (Cage), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Veigar wins by caging your E engage, dropping Dark Matter on the stun, and executing you with Primordial Burst when low.
